author: More Perfect Union
description: This week Mark Zuckerberg and Meta are on trial for harming young children by addicting them to social media. Whistleblowers have revealed that they knew for a long time how their algorithms could be damaging, and took advantage of people's desire for connection anyway. At this week's trial, taking place in California, Zuckerberg said in defense that he handled the issue "in a reasonable way.”
title: Meta is on trial for addicting kids to social media

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Tourism in Vegas is down, but gambling revenue is up. How does that work?

Vegas is a microcosm of the whole economy — it caters more and more to the super-rich, while everyone else is squeezed out.

We went out to talk to locals, who say this lopsided approach can't last.
-----

More Perfect Union is an Emmy-winning, nonprofit newsroom whose mission is to build power for working people. Here’s what that means: We report on the real struggles and challenges of the working class from a working-class perspective. We attempt to connect those problems to potential solutions. We report on the abuses and wrongdoing of corporate power. And we seek to hold accountable the ultra-rich who have too much power over America’s political and economic systems.
